about_the_game:
Hot and Lovely: Seduction is a game that combines classic match-3 gameplay with beautiful girls! Players will unlock the beautiful illustrations of several beautiful girls with distinct personalities by eliminating colored blocks, and experience the heart-moving moments with them.

  • 22 beautiful illustrations: Delicate and beautiful illustrations, from girls' daily playfulness to private ambiguity🥰

  • 4 charming female characters: Each beautiful girl has a unique personality and background, is she a strong sister or an obedient kitten? 🤭

  • Combination of leisure and challenge: easy-to-use match-3 levels, combining fun and strategy🤗

  • One-click skip function: easily skip the difficult questions and go straight to the illustrations for a stress-free experience!

Spend a relaxing and interesting time with many beautiful girls, the real fun lies in exploring their personalities and secrets. The game is centered on easy match-3, and each level revolves around the daily needs of girls!

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains common adult content such as slightly revealing clothing and provocative poses
